ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Visible; macro-level ratio of high-intensity (white/grey) to low-intensity (black/dark brown) pixels is approximately 60:40 across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distinct high-contrast dark pigmentation band along the trailing edge (approximately 15% of surface depth). The interior lobe surfaces feature white/grey regions with numerous dark vertical/radial streaks (mottling) localized predominantly on the mid-sections of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 40 degrees; the absolute vertex is obscured by water splash and surface turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency serrations. Distal tips exhibit extreme high-amplitude pixel-level variations due to localized surface accumulations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory observed from the median notch extending to the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, roughly circular textured clusters concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes, characterized by high-intensity (white) and medium-intensity (brownish) pixel groupings.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions oriented vertically/radially across the light-colored ventral surface, consistent with rake marks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological encrustation (barnacles) on the far distal margins of both lobes, significantly altering the geometric silhouette of the fluke tips.
